about: Phrases read by the Evado service's parser (POST /parse; src/lib/parse.ts) for an account in UTC that reads numeric dates month first (`dateOrder`: `mdy`, so 3/4 is March 4) unless a phrase gives its own `dateOrder` (`dmy` makes 3/4 3 April; issue #376), at the instant in `now` (Thursday 1 October 2026) unless a phrase gives its own. `service` is how the service read it: the title with the date words removed, the day (YYYY-MM-DD), the time of day (HH:MM, empty when the todo has no time), the recurrence rule, `assumed` (am or pm) when a time was typed without am/pm and one reading was assumed, and `passed` when the time had already passed today: `kept` when the phrase said today, tonight, or this morning, afternoon or evening, so the todo stays on today at that time with no reminder (the web offers "Tomorrow instead"), `moved` when no day was said and it went to tomorrow at that time (the web offers "Keep today"), and empty otherwise, including for repeats. tests/parser-corpus.test.ts keeps this file equal to what the parser does; run `UPDATE_CORPUS=1 npx vitest run tests/parser-corpus.test.ts` after a parser change and commit the diff. Clients with their own parser can test themselves against it. A client that reads a phrase differently on purpose can say so and why in its own copy of the file. Date-only weekdays naming today use the account local date throughout that day; explicit next weekdays mean the following week. A smart reading may be recorded in an optional smart field for review, but this file only asserts the deterministic service reading.
aboutThisCopy: This is the service's docs/parser-corpus.json as of 2026-11-18, with its `about` and `service` readings unchanged. TestParseCorpus reads each phrase with local.ParseWith as of the same instant, with the same `dateOrder`, and holds it to `service`. A phrase with a `local` reading is one this reader reads differently on purpose, and `why` says so. The last 9 phrases are not in the service's file: they were recorded from the service by hand on 2026-10-03 for issue #64 (boundary clocks and calendar month ends) and are kept here. To refresh, copy docs/parser-corpus.json over this file, put this note, each `local` and `why`, and those last phrases back, and drop any `local` the service now reads the same way; the diff against the service's copy then shows only those.
